name: Eprosartan

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States

examples.title: Host Response Mediators in Coronavirus (COVID-19) Infection - Is There a Protective Effect of Losartan and Other ARBs on Outcomes of…

summary: In the United States, eprosartan carries a boxed warning, which is the strongest type of safety alert on a medicine's label. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a high risk score of 66 for the liver and a low risk score of 45 for the heart [M]. Additionally, a research study involving the drug was stopped because an independent monitoring committee concluded that continuing it would not be useful or effective [4].
